scope: Finite conditional correspondence for sender envelope/control preparation and fresh replica recovery; not a general simulation or privacy proof.
public_inputs: public configuration and original signed gateway requests
approved output values bound to operation
dataset-independent preparation kind and cut schedule
excluded_generator_inputs: witness head, receipts or commit bit
private dataset, tape, accumulator or result storage
observation_boundary: Includes trusted coordinator method completions and recovery notifications alongside signed gateway/delivery traffic. Failure contains no output body or commit marker. This is not an exhaustive attacker network view.
authority_boundary: Only after_witness_accept and later cuts retain this transaction in authority; before that, retain the entire previous authoritative state, including any previously prepared body.
local_commit_boundary: after_v2_envelope_commit / after_v2_control_commit and response_drop only; earlier cuts roll local SQLite transaction back.
recovery: All modeled events are paused until an explicit PREPARE_RECOVER restores a fresh sender from unchanged authority. Diagnostic restoration is separate and never feeds generator inputs.

relations.R1-R4: Existing gateway cache, budget/draw, schedule and publication/ticket projections.
relations.R5-R8: Prepared body/handoff, receiver first facts, confirmations and final prefix. Empty receiver contexts are public trusted setup.
relations.R13: Actual child exit 96, authority/local atomicity, stale guard, untouched receiver authorities, exact protected opaque seed/result/jobs/budget/ticket/descriptor state, byte-exact fresh restore.

negative_controls: premature durability changes terminal envelope hash
renewed deadline wrongly permits expired envelope preparation
excluded: repeated recovery interruption in this profile
DP output distribution or cryptographic indistinguishability proof
